摘要

女版馬份登場，平行宇宙展開

作者介紹 FoYaGe 製作的女版馬份 AI 動畫系列。故事將馬份改寫成校園風雲人物般的傲嬌少女，並安排妙麗、榮恩等角色陸續登場。作者稱讚畫面具有高畫質遊戲或電影 CG 預告片般的質感。

進入第二集後，女版馬份試圖提醒哈利注意危險，卻受到冷淡對待；當哈利遭佛地魔手下襲擊時，她仍挺身相救。然而哈利醒來後喊出的卻是金妮的名字，令她深受打擊。作者也在影片中介紹文字冒險遊戲《7 Days：密室中的未知生活》及相關抽獎活動。

從暗中守護到舞會邀約

第三集以火盃的考驗時期為背景，哈利與女版馬份出現充滿戲劇性的互動。作者認為，將馬份設定為傲嬌並暗戀哈利，比原作後期較為邊緣化的反派定位更有故事張力。隨著張秋、瘋眼穆敵等人物出現，兩人陷入冷戰，馬份家族似乎還為她安排了婚約對象。

後續劇情揭露女版馬份一直在暗中保護哈利。第四集以交錯敘事回顧兩人的出身背景，也呈現天狼星與哈利父母的回憶。哈利拿到父母留下的舞會西裝，準備邀請馬份；她盛裝出場後，兩人又因爭奪舞伴而引發吃醋情節。榮恩出面助攻，故事卻在浪漫關鍵時刻戛然而止。

創作評價與製作觀察

作者高度肯定這部同人作品的規模與改編構想，認為它幾乎像是以原著世界觀重新編寫故事。影片尾聲收錄製作花絮與訪談，作者也觀察到創作者將畫面調暗，可能是為了減少AI 生成影像的不自然感與瑕疵。

值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入了解近期在社群爆紅的《哈利波特》性轉 AI 動畫風潮，一窺粉絲二創如何顛覆經典人設。
  • 分析傲嬌大小姐、小惡魔推手以及病嬌迷妹等不同性格設定下的女版馬份與哈利的戀愛火花。
  • 透過作者穿一石幽默風趣的即時吐槽，精闢探討 AI 動漫生成技術在分鏡、一致性與視覺風格上的優缺點。

摘要

性轉風潮來襲：哈利波特的戀愛喜劇展開

作者穿一石為了挑戰近期網路上掀起熱潮的性轉 AI 動畫，挑選了多部以《哈利波特》為主題的二創作品進行反應評測。首先登場的影片打破了原作氛圍，不僅將跩哥·馬份性轉成傲嬌的千金大小姐，連隨從與榮恩也被轉為女性角色。在這個宇宙中，女版榮恩化身為看似旁觀卻在幕後掌控全局的小惡魔系紅娘，而哈利則陷入了傲嬌馬份、心機榮恩與成熟妙麗之間的多角戀愛修羅場。作者驚訝地發現這部 AI 創作在日系動漫風格的拿捏上相當成熟，宛如一部正統的校園青春戀愛喜劇。

嗑CP校長與荒唐修羅場：甜寵又混亂的霍格華茲

緊接著作者觀看了另一個系列，劇情的超展開節奏更讓人捧腹大笑。在這個故事裡，鄧不利多校長甚至成了哈利與馬份戀情的頭號狂熱推手，在佛地魔威脅逼近之際居然忙著催促哈利趕緊攻略馬份。隨後的續集中，劇情更進一步失控，甚至出現萬聖節全校學生集體扮裝成女版馬份的荒謬橋段。雖然這系列在 AI 視覺一致性上有些詭異且生硬，但極度甜寵的互動與無厘頭的劇情依然帶來了十足的娛樂效果。

病嬌執念爆發：重現經典決鬥的黑暗戀情

影片後半段，風格驟轉為暗黑深沉的病嬌女版馬份系列。不同於先前的純情傲嬌，這部作品中的馬份轉變為對哈利抱持強烈執念的狂熱跟蹤狂。劇中精準翻玩了原作第二集《消失的密室》中的決鬥俱樂部名場面，將石內卜主持的巫師決鬥改編成充滿病態佔有慾的感情對峙。作者對其緊湊的氛圍給予好評，但也忍不住吐槽動畫中女主角隨時都在變動的髮型，真實呈現出當前 AI 動畫生成技術仍待克服的連貫性問題。

================================================

I watched ten gender-swapped AI animations of Harry Potter, and honestly , I’m feeling so much better now. Hi everyone, I’m Chuan Yi Shi. Lately, the gender-swap trend has taken the internet by storm, spawning a ton of fan art, and some of it is actually still being updated. As for me, I decided, since it’s been recommended to me so many times, fine, I’ll pick ten gender-swapped AI animations to see how they actually turned out and record my reactions. This should be a pretty fun challenge, right? Anyway, subscribing, liking, and. super thanks would be greatly appreciated. 3, 2, 1, let's go! If you search "MFTS" on YouTube or IG, you can find a ton of gender-swapped animations ; did you know some are still being updated weekly? Anyway, for the first one, let’s go with this: "MFY is a girl , MFY wants to be Harry’s mom." Pardon me, I did a quick search and it seems this might be a re-upload; I couldn't find the original creator, so if you know who they are, please help me add the link. I’ll post links to the other ones I’m watching in the description below as well. Okay, are we starting on the train? Oh no, wait, there are so many changes right from the start. First, not just Malfoy, but both of his sidekicks are gender-swapped too? And Ron—Ron is gone, but Hermione is there; hmm, I guess it’s to give female Malfoy someone to compete with for attention? Right, so now it’s the trope of cute. childhood friend versus the new arrival , the tsundere rich girl, huh. Not bad, not bad, starting off with a love triangle is fine by me. >> Whoa, Harry and Hermione are being way more intimate than in the original. >> Yeah, okay, so this version is called " Nia." Malfoy, I think the sidekicks have new names too, I kinda forgot what they were called. I’ll put them on screen during editing so you guys can compare; they look. pretty much the same, though, let me see . 值得閱讀的理由

  • 比較《死神》黑崎一護與《咒術迴戰》虎杖悠仁的相似之處與各自的主角特色。
  • 分析兩人為何常被認為缺乏主動性，以及故事如何影響他們的存在感。
  • 探討虎杖的角色成長與一護守護同伴的信念，重新檢視他們作為主角的魅力。

摘要

兩位常被低估的主角

作者延續先前比較反派的主題，這次將焦點轉向《死神》的黑崎一護與《咒術迴戰》的虎杖悠仁。相較於人氣高漲的藍染與五條悟，兩位主角都曾被觀眾調侃：一護常被拿來開玩笑，虎杖則因存在感似乎不如身邊的老師而被戲稱為「路人主角」。不過，虎杖在故事後期的表現也讓不少讀者重新肯定他，因此這場比較並非一面倒。

相似之處：招式單調、身世特殊

作者指出，兩人首先都不像其他少年漫畫主角那樣擁有繁複多變的招式。一護主要使用「月牙天衝」，偶爾使出變化招式；虎杖則長期以近身格鬥為主，直到後期才逐漸展現更多能力。其次，他們的身世都與特殊實驗或安排有關：一護的誕生受到藍染暗中操弄，虎杖則與羂索的計畫及宿儺的容器身分緊密相連。兩人最終都被揭示並非尋常之人。

被劇情推著走的主角

作者認為，一護與虎杖最明顯的共同點，是在故事中顯得相對被動。一護時常遭遇掌握大量內情的反派，卻被蒙在鼓裡；藍染不斷暗示他早已安排好一切，千年血戰篇中一護也在不知情的情況下成為友哈巴赫計畫中的棋子。虎杖的存在感則受到整體劇情重心影響：交流會與澀谷事變的敵方計畫、以及死滅迴游中我方的目標，都與五條悟的封印或解封息息相關，令虎杖即使戲份不少，也容易顯得不是故事核心。

虎杖的自我認知與一護的信念

作者指出，《咒術迴戰》試圖避開「天選主角」套路，卻也讓虎杖一度顯得被邊緣化。不過，虎杖在澀谷事件後逐漸理解自己在戰鬥中的位置，甚至將自己視為體系中的一枚齒輪。面對真人時，他承認自己與對方並無本質差異，並將追殺咒靈視為必須承擔的角色。作者認為，若連同正篇與後日談一起看，虎杖的成長脈絡其實相當完整；他最初「希望在眾人簇擁下死去」的願望，也在後來重新獲得呼應。

至於一護，作者替他補充說明：他不像鳴人那樣懷抱宏大的理想，並不代表他的目標不值得肯定。守護身邊的朋友與同伴，本身就是一種重要的信念。一護其實也有令人印象深刻的台詞與時刻，只是相較於更容易被觀眾拿來討論或調侃的角色，他的亮眼片段較為分散。

主角如何展現主動性

影片中段穿插了線上抽賞平台的業配介紹，包含抽賞方式、新會員優惠與活動資訊；作者也提醒觀眾量力而為。回到主題後，作者進一步解釋，雖然虛構角色都是由作者安排，但創作的難處在於營造主角能掌握劇情走向的感覺。常見手法是讓主角懷抱強烈目標，並使他面對難以撼動的社會、階級或歷史阻力，從而凸顯其選擇與抗爭。

作者認為，《死神》與《咒術迴戰》都沒有特別把這種主角主動性放在首位。虎杖大多聽從五條、東堂等人的指示，最後接受自己只是整個系統中的齒輪；一護每次落敗後，則往往被帶去特訓——無論是無法戰勝藍染，還是面對友哈巴赫，都由他人安排下一步。影片在談到一護的訓練經歷時即告中斷，未完整呈現作者最後對兩位主角的評判。

I'm not saying I don't understand why Bleach is the way it is; it's largely due to the era it was born in, and the fact that Kubo is, ultimately, an author who values appearance and style above all else. These two points aside, as the most quintessential shonen battle manga of the early 2000s, Bleach followed a very , very fixed RPG loop: "Meet enemy, get crushed, go home to train and get stronger, then insta-kill the opponent. " In fact, it was likely the work that followed that industry formula most rigidly at the time—surpassing Naruto and surpassing Katekyo Hitman Reborn!. But while watching the Arrancar arc and the Thousand-Year Blood War, I actually found myself wondering from time to time : if Bleach hadn't abandoned its early. supernatural/spiritual vibe to write more heartwarming, short stories about human-ghost connections—like Rukia's brother or Chad's parakeet—would I like it more now? When I first opened the first volume of Bleach years ago, I'm not kidding, my first thought was literally: "Isn't this just an edgy, chuunibyou version of Hanada Shonen-shi?" Note that this is 100%a compliment, okay? On a side note, I recently finished watching the Netflix Taiwanese drama "Let's Talk About Chu," and my favorite characters were the two. ghosts who helped the leads take care of their kids—they were hilarious. As for the ending of Bleach, which part is my personal favorite? Is it the scene where Yuzu offers flowers to the lonely spirits on the side of the road? Because that is the very root of Bleach. Honestly, I think it's precisely because so many shonen manga of that era fell into that shallow cycle of encountering enemies, getting stomped, training, getting stronger, and winning, that more than half of them ended up becoming mediocre by the end. And so, the next generation—starting around 2014—began to.

learn how to incorporate more human psychological depth, choosing not to just rely on the same old clichés of " courage,""bonds," and "friendship." It’s not that these values aren’t important; they certainly still are, don’t get me wrong. But these are just the built-in defaults of shonen manga—who doesn't know these things? What we want to know is, besides that, is there anything else you want to express? No matter how many issues Jujutsu Kaisen's plot may have, it is, after all , a manga born in the modern era, so its. writing is bound to better suit modern tastes. It's like a game released in 2026—even if it's average with no standout highlights, playing it will still feel better and more user-friendly than a game from 1996; it’s about that same idea. But does Ichigo really not have a chance for a comeback like Naruto? Well, of course he still could, it just depends on whether Kubo-sensei is willing to restart the serialization of the "Hell Arc." It’s been five years since the first chapter was drawn, and there’s. been no word since. Although that short first chapter felt like a pretty standard small event from his adult life , serving as an opening and closing, it all still hinges on that Hell arc. Alright, that’s all for today.
